canonical_statement: Every compact Hausdorff simply connected topological three-manifold, represented by a ChartedSpace over EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 3), is homeomorphic to the unit three-sphere in EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 4).
domain_and_universes: universe u; M : Type u; Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: topological three-manifold charts through ChartedSpace Euclidean3
pinned_source_relationship: The canonical expression reproduces the binders and conclusion of the proof_wanted entry in the pinned mathlib PoincareConjecture module. Because proof_wanted emits no retained proof constant, this relationship is statement fidelity only.

killed: changed manifold and sphere dimension from three to four
weakened the homeomorphism conclusion to mere nonemptiness

degenerate_cases: SimplyConnectedSpace supplies nonemptiness and path connectedness, so no separate connectedness binder is added. ChartedSpace uses the no-boundary Euclidean model. CompactSpace and T2Space freeze the closed-manifold convention. Orientability is not an explicit premise because the pinned topological statement does not require one.

alternate_encodings.smooth: The diffeomorphism formulation is not canonical here and requires IsManifold (R 3) infinity M.
alternate_encodings.homotopy_sphere: The generalized homotopy-equivalence formulation is stronger in scope and is not substituted for the simply-connected compact 3-manifold root.

status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates only the exact statement with its checked direct expansion and structural mutations. It does not retain or claim a proof of Perelman's theorem.
